data_points.quote: 2,46,113 Households surveyed from July 2025 to June 2026 in the first national domestic tourism survey since 2014-15
48% / 22% Share of overnight trips in the 365-day group made for pilgrimage, against holiday and leisure
127–132 Overnight trips per 100 households a year, rural and urban
428.55 crore Domestic tourist visits the Tourism Ministry counted in 2025, a 45.5% rise on 2024
about 48% were pilgrimages, 30% were health or medical trips and 22% were for holiday, leisure or recreation.
The Tourism Ministry reported 294.8 crore domestic tourist visits in 2024 and, in its newest compendium, 428.55 crore in 2025
a 45.5% rise driven by a jump in Uttar Pradesh from 64.7 crore to 155.7 crore visits
Pilgrimage and religious 47.7%
Health and medical 29.6%
Holiday, leisure, recreation 22.1%
social visits make up about 89% of the 30-day group
Health travel is a larger share in rural India: 38.4% of rural overnight trips in the 365-day group
Health and medical trip (365-day group) | ₹29,454 | ₹41,649
Business trip (30-day group) | ₹5,179 | ₹6,934
65.1% of rural households against 57.1%, and 46.2% of urban households against 40.6%
Shopping was the largest item of same-day trip spending, at 51% of it in rural areas and 41% in urban areas.
Uttar Pradesh accounted for 15.7%, Tamil Nadu 13.4% and Rajasthan 8%.
Uttar Pradesh | 15.7% | 21.9% (647 million of 2,948) | 36.3% (155.74 crore of 428.55)
